hook: Mechanical loading lets stem-cell heart tissue reproduce a deadly desmin aggregation disease.
summary: Human stem-cell heart tissue carrying the CRYAB-R120G mutation at near-natural levels develops desmin aggregates only when grown under three-dimensional mechanical load. The tissues showed weak contraction tied to poor calcium handling, and the drug itacitinib partly restored it. This is a lab tissue model, and the rescue was only partial.
title: Mechanical forces enable human stem cell modeling of protein aggregation cardiomyopathy.
